mission.title: Umsebenzi
mission.description: I-NetComplex ayisosixhobo sokulawula. Lipatifom elenzelwe ukudibanisa abamelwane, ukulungelelanisa imisebenzi yoluntu, nokuphucula ubomi kubahlali kwiindawo zokuhlala. Sikholwa ukuba uluntu oluxhunyiwe lumemelisa abahlali, lulungiselela ulawulo, kwaye ludala ubudlelwano obuhlala iintsolongwana.
mission.coreBelief: Umgangatho awuso sungumaxesha nje — sisixhobo esiphilayo sabantu, ubudlelwano, namava abangelwanayo. Sakha i-NetComplex ukomeleza ezi nxibano ngoyilo lwezwi kunye neteknoloji ekwamkelekileyo.

features.title: Akha Uluntu Oluxhunyiwe
features.subtitle: Izixhobo ezinamandla eziguqula ii-komplex zokuhlala zibe uluntu olwaziwayo, olubandakanyekayo, kunye nolusenza izibhengezo.

list.title: Uhlahlulo Lwabahlali
list.desc: Yazi abamelwane bakho kunye nohlahlulo olupheleleyo.
list.details: Yenza iprofile yakho ngefoto, izinto ozithandayo, kunye neminqweno. Khangela ngesakhiwo okanye isiqendu. Izulululo zokhuseleko ziqinisekisa ukuba wabelana ngalo only iphi owufunayo.

list.title: Iimfuno Zokugcina
list.desc: Loga, siqhubeke, silungise. Ukusuka kwi-taps ezikhubekayo ukuya kwiisebe zoluntu.
list.details: Thumela iifoto kunye neenchazo. Qhubeka nokuhlaziywa kwimeko ngexesha langempela. Xhumana ngqo namafaki-nkonzo. Nika ikhodi yenkonzo kunye nexesha lokusombulula.

list.title: Amaqela Okubhukisha
list.desc: Bhukisha iindawo ngokulula. Iipools, iiclubhouses, imevaltyu.
list.details: Jonga ukhoyo ngexesha langempela. Cwangcisa amaqela aphindiweyo. Fumana izikhumbuzi ezizenzekelayo. Suswa okanye ulungise ngokulula. Ukuhlanganiswa kweekhalenda.

list.title: Umxholo Woluntu
list.desc: indawo yakho yokuthumela uphuhliso, amabali, kunye nezaziso.
list.details: Umhleli wombhalo onamandla aneefoto kunye neevidiyo. Yahlula umxholo ukuze lufunyanwe lula. Commenta uze usabele kwiintsapho. Lawula ngeengqwalasela zoluntu.

list.title: Upengululo & Amaphulo
list.desc: Buza uluntu lwakho. Fumana iimpendulo ezisemgceni. Imibuzo ekhawulezayo, imvakalelo ekhawulezayo.
list.details: Yenza iimpendulo ezininzi, ukulinganisa, kunye nemibuzo evulekileyo. Iimpendulo ezingenakwaziwa okanye ezibiziweyo. Ukubonakaliswa kwemiphumo ngexesha langempela. Khuphela idatha ukuzeuhlalutye.

list.title: amaqela aNhlangano
list.desc: Fumana abantu bakho ngaphakathi kwekomplex yakho. Xhumana ngeenxa zokufuna.
list.details: Yenza uze ujoyine amaqela angenxa zokufuna. Amaqela angasese okanye agcinweyo. Ukucwangcisa iziganekukufa ngaphakathi kwamaqela. Uhlahlulo lwamalungu kunye nemiyalezo.

list.title: Iziganekukufa Zoluntu
list.desc: Fumana kwaye ulungele iziganekukufa ezisondeza uluntu lwakho.
list.details: Yenza iziganekukufa ne-RSVP tracking. Thumela izikhumbuzi ezizenzekelayo. Thengisa amatikiti okanye collections. Ukwabelana ngeefoto emva kweziganekukufa. Amashedyuli eziganekukufa aphindiweyo.

list.title: i-Web3 Digital Identity
list.desc: Akha ulawulo loluntu olusikelwa kwindawo yobunikazi bedijithali.
list.details: Iinkqubo zokuvota ezisekelwe kwi-token. Ulawulo lwentlawulo yoluntu. Ama-NFT anomembership. Uqinisekiso lobunikazi obusikelwa kwindawo. Ukuzenzekelayo kwe-contract esmart.

list.title: Ukuhlaziywa Kweelwimi
list.details: Guqulela umxholo, izaziso, kunye ne-interface kwiilwimi ezininzi ngokuzenzekelayo.

list.title: i-Agent Gateway
list.desc: Dibanisa abantu kunye nam agents emishini kwiinkqubo zoluntu.
list.details: Xhumana, Inkxaso elawulwayo, Inkxaso ye-AI. Ukuhlaziywa kweemfuno zokugcina ngokuzenzekelayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwekhaya le-smart. Uncedo olusekelwe ilizwi.

list.title: Imarketplace
list.desc: Thenga kwaye uthengise ii-services kunye neempahla kuluntu lwakho.
list.details: Imarketplace yendawo yabahlali. Ukul_PROCESSA payments okhuselekileyo. Inkqubo yovavanyo kunye nokunikela ikhadi. Imiyalezo lang مباشرة phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi.

list.title: Imfundo
list.desc: Fumana izibonelelo zemfundo kunye namathuba okufunda.
list.details: I-Portal yee-Bursaries, ii-courses ze-online kunye namavidiyo. Iziganekukufa zokufunda zoluntu. Ukwabelana ngezibonelelo. Ukufunda ngabalingane. Ilayibrari yomxholo wezemfundo.

cta.title: Ikompleks Yakho, Exhunyiwe
cta.description: Joyina amawaka eendlela eziguqula indlela abamelwane baxhumana ngayo, benxibelelana, kwaye baphumelela. I-NetComplex iyenza kube lula ukwakha uluntu olunamandla oluxhunyiweyo.
